title: Prove the exact rank-one repair tariff for weighted wrappers (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration. The exact minimum number of added invertible rank-one linear corrections needed to turn the weighted ordinary wrapper into interchange is `rank(P^2-I)`, for every field and invertible first map P. The second callee may be chosen freely, corrections may be inserted at arbitrary cuts, and arbitrary finite dirty workspace must be restored.

```text
C = P^-2-I = sum_i u_i phi_i
Q = P
middle D += H; then D += u_i phi_i(H) for each factor
    => exact interchange with rank(P^2-I) corrections
arbitrary cuts + restored dirty workspace
    => telescoping endpoint rank lower bound gives the same minimum
```

Jerry Chen / CubeJerry's merged [PR2950](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2950) already proves the optimum endpoint error rank of the unchanged word. The new result constructs exact repairs and proves their minimum count for a changed instruction alphabet. That predecessor's census is not replayed. Only six files in `research/wrapper-rank-one-repair/` are added. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Jerry Chen, the retained Nick Petalas / David Arias / Jose Manuel wrapper and caller lineage, and classical rank factorization and rank subadditivity.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19362351). Base and refreshed canonical main are `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8. The delivered scope matches the claim. Live claims, local reservations, recent account work, open PRs, merged formula/object searches and main README searches were checked. Cached complete pagination covered 387 open PRs and 6,323 Discussion records; sparse local notes, arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits.

## Evidence

Before, the fixed-word error-rank bound does not provide an inserted-correction construction or its tariff. After, PROOF.md proves the exact tariff, and the new standalone verifier checks the actual corrected endpoint:

- Every invertible first map in GL1 and GL2 over F2, F3 and F5: 541 constructions pass. All 786 finite-field single-correction omissions leave a rank-one error.
- Two exact rational fixtures pass with correction counts two and one.
- The complete shorter-repair domain for one rank-two F2 example retains one arbitrary dirty helper, all six second maps, all 465 invertible rank-one perturbations on the full five-dimensional state and all seven cuts. All 19,536 zero- or one-correction circuits fail the full endpoint. The attaining two-correction word passes.
- Five further controls reject a wrong sign, a wrong cut, a mismatched second map, a singular map and a nonsquare map.
- Local CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64, standard library only: warning-strict normal and optimized commands pass in 0.48s and 0.52s; registered replay passes in 1.22s. The generated normal and optimized receipts agree exactly. Both registered commands have a 60-second limit.
- Package metadata and pins, source compilation and function bounds, staged whitespace, six-file exact committed-byte/source-history checks, and an optimized Git-free six-file replay pass locally. The worktree is clean at `eb633feca85a44cb5476a34fd3f9da4960be2315`.

From the worktree root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/wrapper-rank-one-repair/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/wrapper-rank-one-repair/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/wrapper-rank-one-repair
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/wrapper-rank-one-repair --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 path may replace the interpreter prefix. Expected markers are `PASS_WRAPPER_RANK_ONE_REPAIR`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The verifier writes nothing and emits a generated receipt bound to all six package hashes. No receipt is hand-written.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This explicitly changes the joint-query-controller card to an algebraic side result. One abstract rank-one correction is not claimed to cost one scalar ADD or native call. Functional access, broadcast, coefficient preparation, routing, frames, physical restoration, stock, precision, compiler, and complete supplier/outer costs remain unpriced. No new kappa, physical supplier, selected-frontier change or complete multiplication theorem is claimed.

The universal statement rests on the written proof. The finite evidence has exactly the declared domains. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Predecessor scientific suites, the selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. No registered check is deferred to CI alone. A separate Python linter/type checker was not run; source compilation, explicit guards and warning-strict replay passed.

## Open next questions

- Pin one actual weighted producer and price this correction schedule against a fully charged alternative normalization, including functional evaluation, broadcast, preparation, movement, frames and restoration. No such physical implementation is supplied.
- Fix an actual caller's accessible row/column dictionary and chronological cut, then determine the minimum restricted factorization length of P^-2-I. The unrestricted rank theorem does not settle that quantity.

## Related open work

- [PR6406](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6406) counts regular J3 optimal second callees in the unchanged word. This result changes the instruction alphabet and counts inserted corrections. No J3 counts or additional comparison computations are made here; its follow-up questions are not pursued.

- [PR6443](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6443) studies the correction rank of a unitary-encoded Clifford child. This theorem counts inserted rank-one corrections in the ordinary wrapper; the endpoints and encoder constraints differ. No shared numerical instance is computed or rechecked.

The completion refresh inspected the fourteen other open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM: #6437 through #6441 and #6443 through #6451. PR6443 is the additional related entry above. None reports a conflicting value for the declared wrapper repair instances; no extra computation was run to check another contribution.

Merged PR2950 is the direct predecessor. Merged PR4850 and PR5228 respectively concern output-coordinate scaling and the equality set without inserted corrections. Wentao Li's merged PR4053/PR4063/PR4070/PR4095 concern distinct output-normalization and Boolean-invoice contracts. Their results are context, not audit targets or claims of this contribution.

The completed checks were read once; run metadata confirms completed success and the matching head. Hosted replay executes both registered normal and optimized checks. All registered checks, exact committed-byte/source-history checks and the optimized Git-free replay also passed locally. This certifies execution of the scoped automated checks; independent human and formal proof-kernel acceptance of the universal written argument remain unclaimed. No failed check remains.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. One new opt-in research package. Shared code, frozen evidence, other contributors' credit and the selected frontier are unchanged.
